QV rate assumes new-build erection with crane access; a retrofit factor of 1.5-2.0x is applied in the band below and is my judgement, not a published figure. components.role: structural engineer design, AS/NZS 1170 wind and uplift, PS1
components.caveat: NOT IN QV - QV publishes no consultant fees, and no NZ practice publishes a fee schedule for this. Built from 15-30 engineer hours at NZD160-220/hr charge-out, the charge-out derived from published salary data at a conventional 2.5-3x multiplier. Corroborated only loosely by NZ solar industry commentary quoting NZD2,000-10,000 for commercial structural assessment. A CPEng design or review is mandatory here, not optional: since 23 Oct 2025 a roof array over 40 m2 (this is ~120 m2) is exempt from building consent only with CPEng involvement.
